entry.title: New: Bill 39 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES AND DEPARTMENT OF MANAGEMENT, OFFICE OF RECOVERY" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget to 1) increase Carryover/Savings, General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $8,000,000; 2) amend Department of Management, Office of Recovery to increase Category B - Operations & Equipment and Total by $8,000,000; and 3) increase the Total Operating Appropriations and Total Appropriations by $8,000,000.
